description: NaSmSiO₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/m space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.77 Å. Sm is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.87 Å. Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.67 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sm, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, three equivalent Sm, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na, one Sm, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄SmSi octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°.
